description: Keeps the deliberately-pinned versions fresh: Terraform providers (terraform manager), umbrella-chart dependencies in kubernetes/apps/**/Chart.yaml (helmv3 manager), container images in helm values (helm-values manager, e.g. the cloudflared image), the helm chart pins living in *.tfvars, and the Kyverno CLI pin in the cluster-policy-check workflow via the annotated regex managers below.

customManagers.description: Helm chart pins in *.tfvars annotated `# renovate: helmRepo=<url> chart=<name>`

Kyverno CLI pin in the cluster-policy-check workflow. The github-actions manager does not see it: it is an env var, not a `uses:`. Should track the kyverno chart's appVersion so CI evaluates policies on the engine the cluster runs.
